{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Count the number of loyal completed orders
num_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print both numbers to ground the evidence
print(f"Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {num_loyal_completed}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
